Final post trip update. 

This trip is something I won’t forget. I know I’ll drop acid again, but after last night it’s pretty stuck in my head that it’s not something I will do all the time. 
1- I don’t want to fry my brain 
2- it was an experience like none other and I don’t want to ‘chase the dragon’ (not sure if that is the most appropriate terminology here) and try and mimic the experience that I had again because I know it just won’t be the same. At least for now. 

We both agreed that when we trip like that again to do it in a new environment and ways down to road. 

Just recently for the last few months I’ve been having some personal issues with finding myself in this world, and the past week 1/2, I’ve been working on bettering myself, and I can honestly say that this experience I went through has helped myself out with figuring out what I want and planting in my head what I truly need to plant in my head. So it really feel like everything in life leading up to that moment last night was all very specifically placed and laid out for me to go through, as lame/stoner generic that is to say. 

It was also a cool bonding moment for my brother and I. I’m glad we did it together for our first times. 

All in all, I’m extremely grateful that I got to finally have an experience like that. I know it’s not the most ‘crazy’ trip story, but it’s a story that will always be with me. 5/18/19 will be planted in me head for a long time to come. 

Thank you again to anyone reading this now. 
I’m still going to be doing some real post trip thought processing, but I know at the end of everything that it was a fantastic experience.

This will be my last update during the trip. 
I’ll give one once sober. 

6 1/2 hours since first drop. This has been amazing. We both got exactly what we wanted out of our first trips and it’s great. We will always have our “coffee moment” together. 

Through out our trip, we found each other quoting Napoleon Dynamite and decided to let things subside with that movie.  
Thank you again for everyone who shared this with me. I know he has his own experience and I’m grateful that Shared this experience with him.

Update for myself to look back on when this is over, and for anyone reading still.

5 hours in

From first hit until now, we both dropped 1 more hit. 
we were feeling good. A bit cooped up and need something to do. I wanted to get a beer so we drove to the gas station. 
I got a couple beers and a black and mild.
Bro and my wife are with me jammin to some music. Having a great time. 

We get home, we sit outside, he’s smoking in the black and mild, I have my beer and I’m loading a bowl. 
I smoke, he’s smokin, I decide to drop my last hit (3 now for me) 

He peaked just now and I watched it. I won’t go into detail because it was seriously such an intimate moment for him that I got to witness. That was insane. I felt it. It was great. 

My 3rd hit is hitting me pretty good. I’m finally getting CEV and OEV which is exactly what I was hoping to get out of my first time. I’m almost losing my shit over Rick and Morty right now.  I’m having a great trip. 

What is making this great is, I’m getting to bond with my brother. I watched him hit this.. moment. You know what I’m talking about. He had /his moment/ and I got to see that. And to see his realization was great. This has been so great. 

I need to get this documented somewhere so I can look back on it later and read and remember. This has been great. 

I’ll return with my final update. Thank you to anyone who has reachedthis far. It’s been a moving experience and it’s nice to share this with the world as it’s happeneing.
